subject: Market-rate sprint: 1M token target benchmarks and next steps
messages:
From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example>
To: Seth Romero <seth@avacloud.com>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@avacloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Market-rate sprint: 1M token target benchmarks and next steps

Seth / Leah — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and a couple of asks so we can pull a tight price/benchmark packet for you by EOD Monday.

Call highlights (high-level):
- Workloads: customer-facing chat (primary), ingestion + embeddings for retrieval (secondary).
- Expected monthly token mix: chat ~70% (multi-turn), embeddings ~30%.
- Latency target: 200–400ms p95 for chat.
- Compliance: standard SOC2 plus data isolation (we discussed Dedicated/VPC).

Clarifying asks / next steps I promised:
1) Confirm expected committed monthly tokens (ranges ok) and which workloads we should prioritize in the econ model (chat vs embeddings).
2) Confirm target price band you’re trying to hit on a $/1M tokens basis for the production tier (ballpark is fine: e.g., $X–$Y / 1M).
3) Any procurement timing or sign-off constraints (PO cycle, finance approver)?

My working assumptions for the benchmarking pack: committed monthly volume = 30M–50M tokens (chat-heavy), target $/1M ~ $8–$12 (we'll tune after your confirmation). We’ll compare Redwood hosted/dedicated/private economics vs OpenAI / Anthropic / major open-model hosts.

If you confirm the volume band and target band above, we’ll produce:
- a short 1-pager benchmark grid ($/1M, latency, SLA notes),
- a 2-slide summary of commitment tiers and expected unit economics at your mix,
- suggested next steps (pilot vs 12-month commit).

Proposed next meeting: 30 minutes Wed 11/3 to review the benchmark and a pilot proposal. Does 10am PT work?

Thanks — Markus
Markus Klein
Senior Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
m: +1 (415) 555-0193

From: Seth Romero <seth@avacloud.com>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example>
Cc: Leah Park <leah.park@avacloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T11:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Market-rate sprint: 1M token target benchmarks and next steps

Thanks Markus — short answers below. Good call earlier.

1) Committed monthly tokens (range):
   - Pilot phase (first 3 months): 10M–15M total / month.
   - Production target (months 4+): 40M–60M total / month.
   - Mix: chat 75% / embeddings 25% (chat includes generative & system prompts).

2) Target $/1M tokens: our procurement/finance team has given a target band of $9–$12 / 1M for production. For pilot we can tolerate 15–25% premium.

3) Procurement timing: standard enterprise PO + 30-45 day payment terms. Decision window: end of Q1 (we want pilot in Dec 2026, production March 2027).

Notes: latency is important for chat; if Dedicated + caching gets us sub-400ms p95 we'd be happy. Also we'd like to see a clear comparison vs Anthropic and a typical open-host; include any pass-through model fees.

Thanks — Seth
Seth Romero
Head of Product, AvaCloud
seth@avacloud.com

From: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Seth Romero <seth@avacloud.com>, Leah Park <leah.park@avacloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-01T12:20:00-07:00
Subject: Fwd: Market-rate sprint: 1M token target benchmarks and next steps

Ben / Monica — looping you in. Seth confirmed committed ramps (pilot 10–15M, production 40–60M) and a target band of $9–$12 / 1M for production. Procurement timeline: pilot Dec, production March.

Can you pull a short comparative packet that covers:
- $/1M token pricing (OpenAI, Anthropic, two open-model hosts we commonly reference)
- Redwood Hosted baseline, Dedicated (with 12-month commit tiers), and Private (on-prem estimate) economics for AvaCloud's mix (chat 75% / embeddings 25%)
- Notes on latency expectations and what tier drives 200–400ms p95 for chat
- Recommended short pilot pricing and a suggested committed price at 40–60M that meets Seth's $9–$12 target (include any discount assumptions)

Deliverable: 1-slide benchmark grid + 1 slide recommendation by EOD Monday. Attach the workbook and a sample MOP (commit terms) if available.

Thanks — Markus

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.example>
To: Markus Klein <markus_klein@redwood.example>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.example>
Cc: Seth Romero <seth@avacloud.com>, Leah Park <leah.park@avacloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-02T14:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Market-rate sprint: 1M token target benchmarks and next steps

Markus / team / Seth — attaching the benchmark + initial recommendation pack. High-level takeaways below (see attachment for line-by-line math).

Attachment stubs: 20261101_avacloud_benchmark_v1.xlsx (xlsx, 72KB), Redwood_commit_terms_MOP.pdf (pdf, 98KB)

Snapshot (all numbers $/1M tokens, normalized to AvaCloud mix chat 75% / embeddings 25%):
- OpenAI (public API): ~$24 / 1M (baseline for high-capability chat models; lower for embeddings-only workloads).
- Anthropic (public API): ~$18 / 1M (chat-optimized tiers).
- Large open-host (managed LlamaX hosts): ~$9–$12 / 1M (range depends on model family & latency SLA).

Redwood economics (recommended structure):
- Redwood Hosted (no commit): $14 / 1M (fast onboarding, elastic).
- Redwood Dedicated (12-month commit, 40–60M tier): $9 / 1M (meets AvaCloud target band with commit + caching assumptions).
- Redwood Private (on-prem estimate for high sustained volume): ~$6 / 1M equivalent (CAPEX/OPEX amortized; needs sizing call).

Recommended next steps for AvaCloud:
1) Pilot (Dec): 10–15M/mo on Redwood Hosted with performance instrumentation + 1-week dedicated perf test (cost ~ pilot run-rate * 1.15).
2) If pilot meets latency/SLO: move to a 12-month Dedicated commitment at the 40–60M tier; propose $9 / 1M as the committed unit price with quarterly usage true-up and standard SLA.
3) Finance/procurement: provide a draft MOP with 30–45 day terms and a clause for capacity scaling.

I included the per-model breakdown and assumptions in the workbook (tokenization assumptions, prompt length distributions, KV cache hit-rate = 30% during steady state, batching improvements). If you want, Monica and I can join the Wed 11/3 10am PT call and walk through the workbook.

Ben Carter
Head of Growth Pricing, Redwood Inference
